words.english_meaning: The subjects and content included in a course of study.
words.gujarati_meaning: શૈક્ષણિક અભ્યાસક્રમ — શાળા કે કૉલેજમાં ભણાવવામાં આવતા વિષયો અને સામગ્રીઓ.
examples: The new curriculum includes digital literacy.
Teachers must follow the national curriculum.
She helped design the school curriculum.
The curriculum was updated to include climate science.

words.english_meaning: A formal talk given to a group of students on an educational subject.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિદ્યાર્થીઓને કોઈ વિષય પર professor દ્વારા આપવામાં આવતું ઔપચારિક ભાષણ.
words.usage_note: In universities, 'lecture' usually refers to a large-group class given by a professor.
words.memory_tip: 'Lecture' = લૅક્ચર — professor જ્ઞાન આપે, વિદ્યાર્થી સાંભળે.
examples: The professor gave an interesting lecture on economics.
She missed the morning lecture.
Lecture notes are available online.
He attended three lectures today.

words.english_meaning: An outline of topics to be covered in a course or class.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વિષય કે કોર્સમાં શું ભણવાનું છે તેની રૂપરેખા — અભ્યાસ-માળખું.
words.usage_note: 'Syllabi' is the Latin plural; 'syllabuses' is also acceptable.
words.memory_tip: 'Syllabus' = સિલૅ‌બ‌સ — exam માટે શું ભણવું? syllabus જો!
examples: The syllabus lists all the topics for the semester.
The teacher distributed the syllabus on the first day.
We need to complete the syllabus before exams.
The new syllabus includes extra chapters.

words.english_meaning: A task or piece of work given to a student by a teacher.
words.gujarati_meaning: શિક્ષક દ્વારા વિદ્યાર્થીને સોંપવામાં આવેલ કાર્ય અથવા ગૃહકાર્ય.
words.usage_note: Assignments can be individual or group work; they often count toward the final grade.
examples: The assignment is due on Friday.
She worked all night on her assignment.
Group assignments teach teamwork.
The teacher graded the assignments.

words.english_meaning: The act of being present at school or class.
words.gujarati_meaning: શાળા અથવા વર્ગમાં હાજર રહેવાની ક્રિયા; હાજરી.
words.usage_note: Regular attendance is often compulsory; low attendance may result in penalties.
examples: The teacher marked attendance at the start of class.
Her attendance record is excellent.
Poor attendance can affect your grade.
Students must maintain 75% attendance.

words.english_meaning: A private teacher who gives individual or small-group instruction.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાનગી રીતે ભણાવનાર શિક્ષક — વ્યક્તિગત ધ્યાન આપીને ભણાવે.
words.usage_note: A tutor provides personalized help outside regular classes.
words.memory_tip: 'Tutor' = ટ્‌ĥ‌ĥ‌ĥ‌ĥ — ઘરે ભણાવવા આવે, personal teacher.
examples: She hired a tutor to help with mathematics.
The tutor meets with students twice a week.
He works as a tutor after school.
A good tutor identifies a student's weak areas.

words.english_meaning: A half-year term in a school or university, typically lasting around 15-18 weeks.
words.usage_note: Most universities divide the year into two semesters; some use trimesters.
examples: The semester starts in July.
She passed all exams this semester.
The semester ends in December.
He improved his grades every semester.
